provenance.text_editability: Ordinary labels are native typeable text. Mathematical expressions are editable source glyph paths, not live equations.
provenance.image_reconstruction: 70 separate original raster components retain source SVG alpha masks, affine transforms, inverse clips and global figure crop. The 17 gradient dots keep their cubic clips. Five raster shadows of words are omitted so typeable labels leave no old lettering when edited. PDF soft-mask Matte premultiplication is reversed before mask compositing, matching source plot colors. Surface plots remain isolated original images without invented data.
extraction_warnings_reviewed: Source images/shadings are reconstructed individually in source paint order. Native crop-crossing paths are white canvas or zero-opacity framing boxes. Clipping was reviewed in the source and reconstruction; the dots use exact source cubic clips. Raster word shadows are intentionally omitted.
